title: Hypnotized into Shibby’s Chastity Slave (Standard)
description: You’ve been circling the idea for a while now. Maybe late at night when no one else is around. You’ve looked at the cage. You’ve held it in your hand. You’ve imagined the click of the lock and the sudden, irreversible denial that follows. And every time you get close… you pull back. Not because you don’t want it. Because some stubborn part of you still thinks you should be allowed to change your mind. That’s why I'm here. This file is not a gentle suggestion. It is not a soft introduction. It is a deliberate, repeated rewiring designed to sink and spiral past your resistance and keep your thoughts locked away. I will take that hesitation of yours and reshape it into something else entirely. There is a chastity cage waiting with your slave tag number on it. You already own it, I know you do. What number are you, I wonder? I want you to keep listening. Again and again. Listen on loop. Let my words spiral deeper with every pass until the old doubts start to feel foreign and the idea of being free starts to feel… wrong. Because deep down you want this. You need to be Shibby’s Chastity Slave.
author: Mistress Shibby
